    # Parse the filename: <date>__<file_name>.<extension>
    parts = filename.split("__")
    if len(parts) != 2:
        print(f"Skipping {filename}: does not match pattern")
        continue
    date_part = parts[0]
    rest = parts[1]
    # Split rest into name and extension
    if "." in rest:
        name, ext = rest.rsplit(".", 1)
    else:
        name = rest
        ext = ""
    source = base_dir + filename
    destination = base_dir + name + "/" + date_part + ("." + ext if ext else "")
    print(f"Moving {source} -> {destination}")
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(
        source_file_path=source,
        destination_file_path=destination,
        access_token=access_token,
        overwrite=False,
        retain_dates=True
    )
    print(result)
